sources.entry: MyFin Budget - Personal finances platform (web + REST API + Android) that'll help you budget, keep track of your income/spending and forecast your financial future. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: MyFin is a self-hostable personal finance platform with budgeting, transaction tracking, forecasting, and a REST API backend built on Node.js/Express, with companion web and Android clients.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is the backend API for MyFin, a personal finances platform, and the README points to separate projects for the web app and the Android app. Users can add transactions manually or import them in batches from the clipboard, from a .csv file, or from a bank's homebanking export. Transactions can be split into separate entries, and accounts are tracked with their transactions and balances. Categories and entities segment income and spending, and rules can auto-categorize imported transactions. A month-by-month budget tool (Boonzi-style) and a Stats section show patrimony evolution and a forecast for future years. The README also lists account management, an investing tracker (beta), and white and dark themes, with English and Portuguese support.
how_to_run: Follow the documentation linked in the README for first steps; the README does not give explicit install commands here
notable: Budgeting follows a Boonzi-style month-by-month approach
Imports transactions from clipboard, CSV, or bank homebanking exports
Rules engine for automatic transaction categorization
Multilingual with native English and Portuguese support
Companion web and Android clients live in separate repositories
caveats: Investing feature is currently in beta
Roadmap items such as Goals and better account management are not yet built
Described by the author as a passion project with no commitment to support
